name: Ano Machi no Koi no Uta
source:
Kyohei lives an ordinary life doing nothing special, just enjoying his life with his friends. He gets involved in an accident at a big festival taken place once a year. His ordinary life changes to an extraordinary life since then. This is a love story with four girls until they get away from this extraordinary life.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108114559/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003435]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
恭平过着平凡的生活，没什么特别的事，只是与朋友们一同享受每一天。一次，他被卷入每年一度的大型祭典所发生的事故。自那以后，他平凡的生活变得非同寻常。这是他与四名少女共同经历的爱情故事，直至众人摆脱这段异常生活。

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108114559/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003435]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
